channel.title: ANITA research
channel.description: Notes on AI memory, agents and robots from ANITA.

item.title: Agents move data. Physical AI moves atoms.
item.description: Why we start in a factory's office before we go near its machines, and the four rungs between an AI agent that drafts a quote and a robot that lifts a sack.

item.title: How to read an AI memory benchmark
item.description: Every memory system for AI now quotes a score. Here is what the main tests measure, what they leave out, and five questions to ask any vendor, including us.

item.title: Why a robot should practise before it touches your floor
item.description: A mistake in a computer costs nothing. A mistake on a factory floor costs scrap or a stopped line. How simulation and three plain checks stand between our software and a real robot.
